x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of configMapRef or config must be specified
checkpoint.job cannot be set when checkpointRef is specified
checkpoint.job can only be set in Auto mode
extraClientContainers is only supported with mode=IntraPod
extraClientPods is only supported with mode=InterPod
extraClientPods is reserved for inter-pod GMS and is not implemented yet
eppConfig may only be set when type is epp
at most one component may have type epp
component names must be unique case-insensitively
labelKey prefix must be 253 characters or less
labelKey is required until alternate topology sources are supported
preferredWeight is required when enforcement is preferred
preferredWeight may only be set when enforcement is preferred
